prompts: Create ONE animation contact sheet, exactly TWO columns by FOUR rows = EIGHT consecutive frames in reading order, no gutters, no panel borders, no labels. Canvas 1280x1440, each panel 640x360 16:9. Strict 1990s CPS2/Neo Geo PIXEL ART at native resolution: crisp stepped pixel clusters, bold dark contours, flat 2-3 tone shading, muted restrained colors, same limited palette in all frames. NOT smooth illustration, no antialiasing, no blur, no gradients, no text, no watermarks. Every panel is a fully opaque finished cinematic frame. Coherent same subjects and background, small incremental motion from frame to frame. Do not change camera unless requested. OPENING C4. Use TOP woman in reference ONLY as character identity reference, not panel layout; bottom brown-haired woman must NOT appear. Jyaldi, late20s adult Korean woman tall and curvy but not exaggerated, waist-length straight black hair, red eyes, black TROUSER suit, white shirt, black tie, black leather gloves, black shoes. Full body REAR view centered before the same closed brass elevator at night, red light above. Feet remain planted at identical locations, camera locked, torso stays facing elevator in ALL8 frames. Only head slowly turns over her right shoulder to show partial red-eyed profile. Hair tips and jacket hem flutter gently, no walking, no body turn, no new people. Frames1-2 head faces away;3-6 gradually turns right;7-8 holds side glimpse over shoulder. Keep body size, outfit, lighting and architecture exact. Eight DISTINCT repeated scene frames, not a turnaround sheet. Background fills all panels, dark grey marble lobby.
